title: A black hole for an engine, is that a good or a bad idea?
author: LostRequirement4828
selftext:
New ship added: Umbra

Free to play here: [https://vengeful180-dot.github.io/Need4Space/](https://vengeful180-dot.github.io/Need4Space/)

Mechanics are still evolving, and mobile performance is a work in progress.

Your feedback matters. It will shape where the game goes next.

comments.author: PhantomZenithOrigin
comments.body:
Black holes look like that because of the scale of their accretion disc, a small black hole wouldn't look like that, and a black hole that looks like that would be decimating the surrounding matter.   

Also the mist around your ships is jarring, why does the mist follow the ships?  It reads as 'wrong' to have this mist not behave reasonably.  How is this mist locked into relative location as the ship is accelerating/decelerating  and jerking around turns, etc.

There's so much in this that's just wrong and unreasonable, whose visuals immediate make me reject the theming and it comes off as desperate 'just because' justifications.

Your vehicle's wings being connected to the fuselage via force fields is acceptable, but why a cyclical idle animation?  Why not have the winglets respond to conditions such as acceleration/deceleration?  Have them retract at high speed and pop out while braking, it doesn't make sense in my mind from an engineering perspective why someone would design those winglets to float in and out at arbitrary timings, and so it comes off like an out-of-place toy rather than a real racing vehicle in your universe.

replies.author: LostRequirement4828
replies.body: The mist is locked because of the time dilatation, but I will make it move a little so It's not fully locked

replies.author: PhantomZenithOrigin
replies.body: I think the takeaway as a creator that you could take into consideration is that whether or not there is justification (Time dilation), it visually reads as 'wrong'.

replies.author: LostRequirement4828
replies.body: Yes, I already fixed it in game, It doesn't fully stop anymore, thank you!

replies.author: LostRequirement4828
replies.body: It was basically stopping while boosting the engine, otherwise was normal

replies.author: LostRequirement4828
replies.body: Haha, I see, but is an arcade game, most of the stuff doesn't really need to make sense, like they are racing on a road in the first place. Thank you for your feedback anyway!
